newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Al-Ittihad and other UAE newspapers fronted news of the two-day meeting of six Gulf Cooperation Council foreign ministers in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The GCC condemned the interference in Iraq by neighbouring countries. Oman said there were differences between GCC opinion and the U.S. over Iraq.

- Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy is said to be in talks for the sale of its 50 percent stake in Borealis, awarded a $850 million contract to establish a downstream plant at Ruwais in Abu Dhabi. Abu Dhabi's International Petroleum Investment Co. said to be a contender.
- The start of the first production cells under Dubai Aluminium's $500 million expansion come onstream.
